summary: Tested the 3 Batch 2 photo fixes in the /create wizard live preview at 1920px, logged in with the host cookie. I used an Aqiqah card twice: once with its 2 default events (a multi-event hub card) and once trimmed to 1 event (a single-event card). I uploaded a real 600x750 jpg. FIX2 (Details field order) PASS: the order is intro-title, welcome salutation, greeting and note, header-picker, title, hub-heading, invitation, the 4 blessing buttons, host-family ('With compliments from'), then whatsapp. FIX1 (distinct slots) mostly PASS: all 7 cover slots render exactly 1 figure in a distinct DOM spot on both cards. On multi, before-events sits after the blessing and before hub-heading, and end sits after the timeline and before the closing section. On single, before-events and end are distinct, but before-events renders BEFORE the invitation message (it follows card-event-title). So 'Before the events list' shows above 'After the invitation message', which is the wrong order. FIX3 (no overlap) FAIL: every inline photo is framed, which is correct. But in 5 positions the photo still runs under the next text, by 26 to 96px: cover after-names, single-event before-events, cover end, event end, and both welcome slots. Event slots top, after-name, after-datetime and after-venue are fine (288px, no overlap). REGRESSION PASS: the hero photo at top and after-header is blended with no overlap. meera-kabir has no figures or empty frames. faraz still shows card-hero-photo blended.

ui_bugs.issue: Photo overlaps the next text. templates.css:199 '.gc-photo-event { aspect-ratio: 16/10 }' is not reset by '.gc-root .gc-photo.has-fit'. has-fit also sets 'overflow: visible', and the shape-full img is 'height:auto'. In some containers the figure box stays 300x188 while the img is 320 to 375px tall, so the image spills out of the box over the following text. Measured overlaps: cover after-names covers card-invitation-text by 54px (multi) and card-event-title by 26px (single). Single-event before-events covers card-invitation-text by 96px. Cover 'At the end' covers card-event-closing ('Your presence will make this occasion memorable') by 62px. Event 'At the end' (card-event-photo-end) covers card-event-closing by 62px. I injected '.gc-root .gc-photo.has-fit { aspect-ratio: auto; }' and the cover figure height then equalled the img height (335 and 375) with no text overlap. That fix is verified.

hub.css:79 '.gc-welcome .gc-photo { max-height: 300px }' caps the figure at 300x300, but the img is 375px tall and overflows. With 'Below the greeting' the photo covers welcome-note ('We cordially invite you...') by about 39px. With 'Above the greeting' it covers welcome-greeting by about 39px, and the greeting line is visibly cut. The figure is also off-centre and runs past the card's right edge: card spans x 1166-1486, figure spans 1194-1494, and the red frame is clipped on the right. The aspect-ratio fix alone does not solve this. The welcome img itself needs a cap, for example '.gc-welcome .gc-photo.has-fit .gc-photo-clip img { max-height: 300px; width: auto; margin: 0 auto }', or remove the figure max-height and fix the centring.

On a single-event card, 'Before the events list' renders straight after card-event-title, before DetailsSection. DetailsSection contains MessageBlock (invitation and blessing). So the photo appears ABOVE the invitation message, ahead of the 'After the invitation' and 'After the blessing' slots, which breaks the dropdown order. It should go inside DetailsSection, after MessageBlock and the dua and before the event .gc-panel.

Event 'After the venue', event 'At the end' and cover 'At the end' all land in the same visible spot on a single-event card: after get-directions-button and before card-closing-section. This is the same kind of duplicate the user complained about for before-events and end.

issues: Photo frame clipped at the card's right edge
Greeting and note text overlapped by the photo

action_items: Add 'aspect-ratio: auto' to '.gc-root .gc-photo.has-fit' in pages.css. This resets templates.css .gc-photo-event 16/10, so the figure box grows with the img and stops the overlap at after-names, before-events, cover end and event end. Verified by CSS injection.
Welcome photo: cap the img height instead of the figure (hub.css:79 max-height 300px on .gc-photo makes the img overflow), and fix horizontal centring and overflow inside .gc-welcome-inner.
SinglePage: move the cover 'before-events' PlacedPhoto inside DetailsSection, after MessageBlock and before .gc-panel, so the slot order matches the dropdown.
Optional: make single-event event after-venue, event end and cover end visually distinct, for example by putting end after ClosingSection.
critical_code_review_comments: The has-fit wrapper sets overflow: visible but does not neutralise the legacy sizing rules: aspect-ratio on .gc-photo-event and max-height on .gc-welcome .gc-photo. Any constrained figure box therefore lets the photo bleed. Fix this at the root in .has-fit.
PlacedPhoto in SinglePage: before-events sits outside DetailsSection, which contains MessageBlock, so the logical order is broken for single-event cards.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (FIX2 pass, FIX1 partial, FIX3 fail, regression pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Wizard cards were never saved, and the DB has no TEST_Yahya, TEST_Single or TEST_Welcome cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The user's card card_cd91c8e4ec84 (slug yahya-nawaz-siddiqui-5) belongs to user_af76decd6f80, so the test host cannot edit it. /create with Aqiqah defaults to 2 events, which makes it a hub/multi card. For a single-event card, click wizard-event-1-remove-button on tab-3. Overlap check: compare each figure's rect with its img rect (figure[data-testid] img), and intersect the img rect with p, h1, h2, blockquote and a elements that are not inside the figure. Ignore watermark SPANs. The welcome screen shows in the preview after wizard-preview-replay-button; intro-open-button may not be present.
rca of the issue: Overlap: templates.css:199 '.gc-photo-event{aspect-ratio:16/10}' plus pages.css:8 '.gc-photo.has-fit{overflow:visible;height:auto}' plus pages.css:15 shape-full 'img{height:auto;max-height:56vh}'. Where the figure is not stretched to its content (block flow), the box stays 300x188 and the 4:5 image paints about 190px beyond it, under the next sibling text. Welcome: hub.css:79 'max-height:300px' on the figure has the same effect. Reproduce: /create, Aqiqah, upload a portrait photo, Cover, 'At the end', then scroll the preview. The closing line is drawn over the photo.
